prompt:
90 年代中国港式武侠漫画美术风格，2.5D 漫画质感，
墨线分明清晰，厚涂上色、色彩饱和鲜艳明亮，

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2D wuxia RPG combat visual-effect sprite sheet.
Primary request: a four-frame effect for the combat family sword arc.
Layout: a strict 2 by 2 grid, each cell exactly one equal square frame, no borders, no labels, no frame numbers. Read left-to-right then top-to-bottom.
Frame 1: a compact cyan-white sword aura gathering.
Frame 2: a sharp diagonal cyan sword arc travelling upward.
Frame 3: a bright white-cyan impact starburst with a few controlled sparks.
Frame 4: thin fading cyan trails and two dim particles.
Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma-key background across every cell.
Constraints: effect only, no person, no face, no weapon, no UI, no text, no watermark, no shadows, no ground plane; keep all pixels inside each cell with generous safe padding; crisp hand-painted 2.5D wuxia comic effects, readable at mobile scale.
Avoid: any #FF00FF inside the effect, extra panels, black background, realistic smoke, photorealism, 现代服装，3D CG 渲染感，照片级写实，
网络红人脸，二次元萌系，迪士尼风，
水印，签名，文字乱码，
繁体中文，繁体字，traditional chinese characters，
错字，简化字写错，
整体灰暗，雾蒙蒙，低饱和，沉郁压抑，黯淡无光，灰蒙蒙的色调
